sloka: सा पाद मूले कैकेय्या मन्थरा निपपात ह ।निह्श्वसन्ती सुदुह्ख आर्ता कृपणम् विललाप च ॥२-७८-२५॥
transliteration: sā pāda mūle kaikeyyā mantharā nipapāta ha ।nihśvasantī suduhkha ārtā kṛpaṇam vilalāpa ca ॥2-78-25॥

translations.english: Manthara, tormented with grief, fell at the feet of Kaikeyi and began heaving deep sighs.
